summary: Refresh six BFF composition test files that required CI does not run. Pure test updates; no production file touched and no assertion weakened.

path_dedupe_ranking_promote.decision: RankingFormulaAction has no executor and fails before admission with 410 ACTION_RETIRED. The case moved out of the deprecated-alias header check into its own explicit 410/ACTION_RETIRED assertion, so the guarantee is still tested.

path_dedupe_persona_promote.decision: Persona promote is a live lifecycle entry point. The still-deprecated nested persona sample is now /actions/archive, which keeps the 410 + X-Deprecated headers assertion unchanged.

final_precondition_missing_approval.decision: ApproveDecision is exempt from the approval-evidence precondition (owner verifies). The 409 HUMAN_GATE_PENDING expectation is kept and exercised with ApproveDeployment + approval_decision, which still requires evidence.

read_surface_cutover_notes.decision: Research single owner: the owner answers experiment reads only. A bare MagicMock answered note reads too and polluted the count. The double is now MagicMock(spec=[experiment methods]); the 1-note count assertion is unchanged.

list_detail_facade_order_dependence.decision: The _PERSONA_PROVISIONING_STORE guard was captured at import time, so another module rebinding the global between collection and the first test failed the module fixture (order-dependent errors). The original is now captured inside the fixture; the restore-and-identity assertions on exit remain. The dataset_surface_status double already returns ok (ed2951d76). Verified alone and after the persona wiring/contract files.

http_smoke.decision: Reads now come from owner APIs under a verified tenant, and ApproveDeployment requires Idempotency-Key and approval evidence. Test now stands up stub Deployment and Governance owners (plan-F-042, appr-dp-001 bound to ApproveDeployment/dp-001), uses tenant-bearing stub tokens, sends Idempotency-Key and approvalId, and waits up to 60s for readiness. All original status assertions are kept.

staging_cutoff.decision: 3619312f3 gave operator-bff a read-only governance journal consumer mount. The static test now requires exactly that one mount, :ro, and the rendered test requires exactly {bff-data rw, governance-data ro}. Rendering needs --profile root (99833357f) and dummy required env (9644a6b5e); a writable or extra mount still fails.

observation_not_changed: With no Governance owner configured, a command carrying approval evidence returns 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (unconfigured RuntimeError from governance_approval_url escapes), while the cleanup default is 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE for an unavailable owner. Not marked as a regression by triage and the production budget is 0, so left for a separate task.

local_verification.command: python -m pytest tests/test_bff_path_dedupe.py test_final_precondition_errors.py tests/test_read_surface_port_cutover.py tests/test_bff_b2_list_detail_facade.py http_smoke_test.py test_staging_read_store_cutoff_contract.py (cwd services/control-plane/bff)
